scripts.build:viewer: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm --filter @manifest/viewer run build
scripts.dev:viewer: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm --filter @manifest/viewer run dev
scripts.generate:schema: cargo run -p manifest-schema-generator && prettier --write packages/manifest-metadata/src/types.ts packages/manifest-metadata/src/version.ts packages/manifest-metadata/schema packages/manifest-runtime/src/types.ts
scripts.check:generated: pnpm run generate:schema && node scripts/src/generate/check-generated-clean.ts packages/manifest-metadata packages/manifest-runtime/src/types.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @manifest/viewer run check
